name: Spire Plus
author: wenhuorongbing-netizen
description: Spire Plus is a Slay the Spire 2 gameplay expansion: Ancient reward reworks, A11-A20 test progression, Rootblight and Blight Sprouts, Firemarked Elites, Banner Rooms, boss dedicated abilities, and preview tools. Requires BaseLib. 中文：Spire Plus 是《杀戮尖塔 2》玩法拓展：先古之民奖励重做、A11-A20 测试进阶、根芽/根蚀、火印精英、战旗房、首领专属能力和预览工具。需要 BaseLib。
